key_insight: UltraX improves pre-training data quality at scale by turning raw text refinement into adaptive, programmatic editing with deletion, modification, and insertion operations.
engineering_relevance: It offers a more reliable and data-efficient pipeline for large-scale LLM pre-training, making corpus refinement more practical for industrial-scale training workflows.
method: Dataset-adaptive prompt optimization generates high-quality refined target texts from an expert LLM.
Line Alignment Mapping plus Dynamic Context Replacement convert text pairs into structured program supervision.
Low-confidence filtering, ratio-controlled sampling, and output normalization stabilize training and inference.
evidence_signal: Experiments in the abstract report that UltraX achieves the highest average performance across all corpora and can match or surpass baselines with fewer training tokens.
watch_item: Its gains depend on careful prompt optimization, filtering, and post-processing, which may add pipeline complexity and implementation overhead.
paper_title: UltraX: Refining Pre-Training Data at Scale with Adaptive Programmatic Editing
